text_block_list.text: The instinct within Still in Love had vanished—

A few months had passed since hearing that report...
Even as the new year arrived, the gloom lingered on her face.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Congratulations...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It feels strange.
Because it's something that's always been inside me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't know where to place my center of gravity...
I'm so wobbly...

"It seems her heart hasn't quite caught up to the changes yet.
That's only natural... but with who she is now,
she ought to be able to be more positive."
choice_data_list: ...Aside from feeling wobbly, how are you?
...Aside from feeling wobbly, how are you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Other than... meaning...?
choice_data_list: Like any troubles in your daily life...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't.
Not at all... if anything...
choice_data_list: Do you feel like you're in good shape?

text_block_list.text: Still in Love is still lost in confusion. But surely, with just one more step forward—she'll gain the composure to look at her situation objectively.
choice_data_list: Alright, how about a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since it's New Year's and all...
Shall we go somewhere?

Last year, she treated me.
So this year, I'll think of something
she might enjoy—
choice_data_list: Praying for a Good Year at Hatsumode

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Afternoon tea......!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure it's alright!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Afternoon tea... with Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
In that case...!
I know just the place to recommend for this time of year.

She took me, a fellow lover of sweets, to a famous hotel lounge.
There, to celebrate the New Year—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "While using traditional Japanese ingredients like matcha and gyuhi, Western sweets like macarons and chocolates are arranged to resemble kadomatsu and kagami mochi."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The chocolate here in this lounge is especially delicious, with seasonal twists served every time...
choice_data_list: I see, I'm looking forward to it.
I see, that's something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I was hoping I could bring you here someday, Trainer...
so I'm really happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a-and so...
In addition to black tea, this place is also known for its wide variety of coffees.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please feel free to taste a bit of everything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—How is it?
That kuromitsu chocolate...
doesn't it go wonderfully with the dark roast coffee?”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I'm so glad...♪
Seeing how touched I was, Still in Love smiled happily... Feeling a little embarrassed, I nonetheless enjoyed our special time together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Visiting the shrine...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Since we're already here...
...shall we go?

And so, heading to the shrine with Still in Love...
we stood side by side and made our wishes.
choice_data_list: (I hope Still gets to live happily.)

text_block_list.text: —And so, I added just one more wish... that Still in Love would have a wonderful year ahead.

She was praying so earnestly for something.
Her profile looked so serious that it makes you wonder what it was, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: May I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what in the world did you wish for...!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
For behaving in such an unseemly manner...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... Trainer, you looked so serious...
I just couldn't help worrying about it...!

It looks like both of them were curious about
each other's wishes. Given her current situation,
her wish would probably be to improve her circumstances, so—
choice_data_list: Maybe they made the same wish as you.
Maybe they made the same wish as you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer.
Are you sure you want the same thing?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Because.
What I wished for was......—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Landing."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Universe-san...!
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Parking orbit"...
I felt called.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Reentry module.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't leave.
Won't you... hang out with me for a bit?
And so, guided by Neo Universe, who came following some mysterious intuition?—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What might that be...?
It looks... like a key.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""MSTR"... But—
It must be a "mystery"."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A mystery... It certainly is.
Shall we try and figure out who it is?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “WDDG”……？

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: We, do, the...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphira.

As the two walked along the beach, they took turns interpreting whatever washed ashore.
Their ideas didn't seem quite aligned, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... So many curious things always seem to gather around you, Universe-san.
choice_data_list: (...Well, Still seems to be having fun, so that's fine.)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Next is... this way.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If you find anything interesting, be sure to let me know too, Trainer... ♪
